data.gist: MSCs differentiate into multiple lineages and act via paracrine signaling; BMAC is a popular autologous MSC source for knee osteoarthritis.
data.plain: Mesenchymal stem/stromal cells can become fat, bone, or cartilage cells and also secrete anti-inflammatory and growth factors. Concentrated bone marrow aspirate (BMAC) is widely used as a patient's own source of these cells, including for knee arthritis.
